content.title: Kobold Delvers
about: Kobold Delvers is my final degree project: a 2D puzzle/sandbox game built from scratch with a custom C++ and OpenGL engine.

The game combines the group-management spirit of Lemmings with a dynamic cellular-automata world inspired by games such as Noita. Instead of relying on a commercial engine, the project focuses on a lightweight technical foundation designed around the exact needs of the game.

The player guides a group of kobolds through interactive levels where materials, terrain, hazards, tools, and objectives are all connected through the underlying world simulation. The project also includes a sandbox mode used to test materials, interactions, and emergent situations.
features: Custom C++/OpenGL game built without a commercial engine
Cellular-automata world simulation with interactive materials
Kobold-based puzzle gameplay focused on guiding, protecting, and using the group efficiently
Handmade levels with objectives, restrictions, and star-based completion goals
Sandbox mode for testing materials, simulation behavior, and creative interactions
Custom rendering, input, UI, audio, and entity systems developed specifically for the project
Steamworks integration with achievements and Steam-ready build pipeline
Original pixel-art assets, interface elements, music, and sound effects

details.role: Solo Developer (Programming, Design, Art, Audio, Steam Integration)
details.category: Final Degree Project / Puzzle Sandbox Game

learnings: Designing a complete game around a custom engine instead of adapting the idea to an existing one
Optimizing a cellular-automata simulation so it can support gameplay instead of being only a technical demo
Connecting low-level systems such as rendering, input, audio, UI, entities, and coordinate transformations into one playable project
Preparing a game for Steam, including achievements, application configuration, and build-upload workflow
Managing the full scope of a solo project: code, design, art, audio, testing, documentation, and presentation
